title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-06-22
content:
Week of 2026-06-22 -- Private Deployments Engineering Weekly

Attendees: Priya Shah (owner), Alex Ramirez, Maya Chen, Jordan Lee, Samir Patel (Solutions Eng), Rowan (SRE)

Objective: Sync on active VPC/on-prem installs, triage customer blockers, review rollout telemetry, and align action items for next sprint.

---
Standup notes / progress highlights

1) AcmeCorp on-prem (PD-4123)
- Current status: Pre-install validation complete; air-gapped package delivery scheduled for 2026-06-24.
- Remaining work: finalize node-level firewall rules doc (security requested a hardening checklist), coordinate KMS key injection process with customer infra team.
- Blockers: Customer is waiting on their procurement to approve HSM appliance; until HSM serial + network details provided, KMS integration tests are blocked.
- Owner: Alex R.
- ETA: Tentatively 2026-07-02 for full install once HSM details available.

2) FinTechCo VPC (PD-4198)
- Current status: VPC peering and private-link tested in staging; canary install began 2026-06-21.
- Observations: Observed 10-15% higher tail latency when KV cache warming occurs during initial traffic spike -- likely due to instance placement across different AZs.
- Actions: Maya to test AZ-affinity placement policy next week; SRE to add temporary read-through cache priming script to reduce cold-start latency.
- Blockers: None critical; customer asked for latency SLO telemetry exported to their Grafana (work in progress).
- Owner: Maya C.
- ETA: Canary -> full rollout by 2026-06-29 if latency stabilizes.

3) RetailCo hybrid (on-prem + cloud burst) -- new intake
- Current status: Intake call completed 2026-06-20; initial architecture suggests private control plane with cloud burst to Redwood Dedicated.
- Risks: Data residency requirements need legal signoff for cloud burst policy; customer may require token redaction before leaving their VPC.
- Next steps: Solutions Eng to draft architecture diagram and data flow, Legal to advise on redaction commitments.
- Owner: Jordan L.
- Blockers: Legal signoff and confirmation of burst regions.

4) Install tooling & automation
- Work done: Added retry/backoff improvements to installer to handle flaky SSH connections during on-prem setup. Reduced installer failure rate in test lab from ~12% -> ~3%.
- Next: Add progress hooks to installer logs so customer-side engineers can tell if a failure is due to network, K8s join, or image pull. Priya to open follow-up GH PR.

5) Observability / Console integration for Private
- Progress: Basic per-route token-level cost telemetry for private deployments is now available in the private console alpha; shipped to two pilot customers.
- Feedback: Pilots requested exportable CSV and Grafana-friendly metrics endpoint.
- Action: Instrumentation team to add Prometheus metrics endpoint for private control plane next sprint.

---
Customer Blockers (high priority)

- Blocker A: HSM procurement delay for AcmeCorp (PD-4123). Impact: blocks KMS onboarding and proceeds to production. Mitigation: Offer temporary software-based key store with clear security caveats for staging only; escalate to CSM to unblock procurement.

- Blocker B: Tail latency for FinTechCo canary due to cross-AZ placement. Impact: potential hold on full rollout if SLOs not met. Mitigation: Test AZ-affinity placement policy; schedule a focused experiment 2026-06-24.

- Blocker C: Legal/data residency for RetailCo on cloud burst. Impact: prevents signing of MSA for hybrid pattern. Mitigation: engage legal and solutions engineering to produce explicit data flow and redaction plan; propose a 1-week RACI to resolve.

---
Action items and owners

- Alex R: Follow up with AcmeCorp procurement and provide temporary software KMS option for staging (due 2026-06-24).
- Priya S: Open installer PR to add clearer progress hooks and update runbook (due 2026-06-25).
- Maya C: Run AZ-affinity placement experiment and report latency histogram (due 2026-06-24).
- Jordan L: Draft RetailCo hybrid architecture + data flow doc and circulate to Legal (due 2026-06-26).
- SRE (Rowan): Deploy cache priming script to FinTechCo canary cluster and monitor (start 2026-06-23).
- Instrumentation: Add Prometheus metrics endpoint for private control plane (sprint goal).

---
Risks / notes

- Installer: While failure rates are improved, we still see edge cases in air-gapped environments (package verification timeouts). Need a small retry window and clearer user messaging in CLI.
- Security: HSM requirement is increasing in enterprise deals -- we should standardize an HSM onboarding checklist in the runbook and surface it during pre-sales calls.
- Capacity: Private Dedicated burst patterns may require autoscaling policies that span private -> dedicated capacity; prod SRE should own a guardrail to avoid runaway costs.

---
Decisions made this week

- Prioritize HSM onboarding checklist in runbook before next enterprise install.
- Approve temporary software KMS for staging environments when HSM delays block progress (documented as acceptable only for staging).
- Proceed with AZ-affinity experiment for FinTechCo; rollback plan in place to revert to cross-AZ if it increases other risk metrics.

---
Notes for next week

- Re-check AcmeCorp HSM status on 2026-06-24; if still blocked, CSM escalations to be logged.
- Validate latency histograms post-AZ-affinity experiment (Maya).
- Share RetailCo architecture + legal plan by EOD 2026-06-26.
- Prep a short presentation for GTM outlining common private deployment blockers and standard mitigations to reduce repeated pre-sales friction.

End of notes.
